descriptions.before: Device safe area insets are added to the fullscreen area. The resulting area is guaranteed to not be occluded by any device screen cutouts such as the camera notch, although no inset is added for Roblox core UI elements like the top bar buttons. As such, it's recommended that you use CoreUISafeInsets for a ScreenGui whose contents should remain unobscured by both device cutouts and core screen elements.
descriptions.after: Device safe area insets are added to the fullscreen area. The resulting area is guaranteed to not be occluded by any device screen cutouts such as the camera notch, although no inset is added for Roblox core UI elements like the top bar buttons. As a result, it's recommended that you use CoreUISafeInsets for a ScreenGui whose contents should remain unobscured by both device cutouts and core screen elements.

descriptions.before: Simulates the deprecated legacy technology using the Voxel system. Not recommended.
descriptions.after: Simulates the removed legacy technology and is not recommended. To achieve a similar look, experiment with another technology setting and add a ColorGradingEffect post‑processing effect set to the Retro preset.

descriptions.before: Legacy lighting technology that is no longer available. Don't use.

descriptions.after: Sets the tone mapper to use the post‑2019 Roblox appearance which provides vivid colors and high contrasts.
Sets the tone mapper to imitate the pre‑2019 Roblox appearance. Colors look less saturated and there is less contrast between them.
